name: rules-rtdb-r29-deploy-rejections
description: RTDB rules deploy verdicts for corpus scenario "r29-deploy-rejections" (rtdb#71). Captured by dry-run deploys to the rules endpoint, which validate without deploying. a ruleset production refuses to deploy must be refused when Pyric loads it, so each refusal and its text is the evidence that turns a local check from a warning into an error.

two $ children of one node.error: Cannot have multiple default rules ('$x' and '$y').

a number as a rule value.error: Invalid rule expression.  Expected 'true', 'false', or an expression string.

an object as a rule value.error: Invalid rule expression.  Expected 'true', 'false', or an expression string.

a number as the .indexOn value.error: Invalid indexOn expression. Must be either a string or an array of strings

length called as a method.error: Type error: Function call on target that is not a function.

a snapshot compared with a number.error: Invalid > expression: left operand must be a number or string.

a rule whose result is a string.error: Expression must evaluate to a boolean.

a rule whose result is a number.error: Expression must evaluate to a boolean.

a snapshot method on auth.error: Type error: Function call on target that is not a function.

an assignment instead of a comparison.error: Rule expressions may not contain assignments.

a string minus a number.error: Invalid - expression: left operand is not a number.

a boolean compared with a number.error: Invalid > expression: left operand must be a number or string.

matches() with a string argument.error: matches() expects a regular expression literal argument.
